name: contract-proof-resource-identity
goal: Ignore transient resource lease identities while retaining meaningful proof environment differences

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A recorded red run on harbor-mbp-2 cannot be paired by a later resource-admitted green run because each admission creates a fresh HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE. The lease identifies resource ownership rather than a workload setting; the same-node green is rejected before executing tests.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing environmentProfile case exercises launcher identity but omits the resource lease introduced by managed commands. Strengthen that same case with distinct leases and explicit unchanged CPU/memory settings; retain assertions that runtime paths, feature flags and resource amounts change the profile. No test declarations added.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing eight-case regression guidance/profile suite fails at ad7672b87b on the named resource-lease identity equality assertion. Its PATH and FEATURE_FLAG distinction checks remain intact, and no test declarations were added.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Exclude only the transient HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE from environment identity. Resource CPU and memory amounts, runtime paths and feature flags remain part of the proof hash; resource admission and safety guards are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same eight cases fail on the lease assertion before repair and pass at 5d23da87c7. Runtime, flags and CPU/memory amount distinctions remain asserted. Broader verification is pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
